title: Quantum Physics: Potential Wells
autoPauseDescription: Automatically pause the simulation when the browser tab is not visible
oneWellScreenSummary: Explore the behavior of a quantum particle confined in a single potential well. Observe how the wave function and probability density evolve over time, and see how changing the well parameters affects the energy levels and quantum states.
twoWellsScreenSummary: Investigate the quantum mechanics of a particle in a double potential well system. Discover how the wave functions split into symmetric and antisymmetric states, and explore quantum tunneling between the wells.
manyWellsScreenSummary: Examine the behavior of quantum particles in multiple potential wells. Study how the energy bands form and how the wave functions extend across multiple wells, similar to electrons in a crystal lattice.
oneWellDescription:
Explore quantum mechanics in a single potential well.
Adjust the well parameters to see how energy levels change.
twoWellsDescription:
Explore quantum tunneling in a double potential well.
Adjust barrier parameters to see how tunneling probability changes.
Watch particles tunnel through classically forbidden regions!
manyWellsDescription:
Explore energy bands in a periodic potential.
Add or remove wells to see how energy bands form.
This demonstrates the foundation of solid-state physics!
oneWellSummary: One Well screen shows a single quantum potential well with adjustable parameters.
twoWellsSummary: Two Wells screen demonstrates quantum tunneling between two potential wells.

oneWellKeyConcepts:
• Quantum confinement in a single potential well
• Discrete energy levels (eigenstates)
• Wave-particle duality
• Probability density |ψ|²
• Heisenberg Uncertainty Principle

• Try different potential types

• Tunneling probability

potentialDescriptions.infiniteWell: Particle confined in rigid box with infinite barriers. Exactly solvable with uniform energy spacing.
potentialDescriptions.finiteWell: Square well with finite barrier height. Realistic model with exponentially decaying wavefunctions outside well.
potentialDescriptions.harmonicOscillator: Quadratic potential resembling mass on spring. Energy levels uniformly spaced.
potentialDescriptions.morse: Models molecular vibrations with anharmonic oscillations. Energy spacing decreases at higher levels.
potentialDescriptions.poschlTeller: Exactly solvable hyperbolic secant potential. Important in quantum scattering theory.
potentialDescriptions.rosenMorse: Variant of Pöschl-Teller with different asymptotic behavior.
potentialDescriptions.eckart: Barrier potential used in molecular physics. Models quantum tunneling through barriers.
potentialDescriptions.asymmetricTriangle: Tilted potential well with linear slope. Models particle in electric field.
potentialDescriptions.triangular: V-shaped potential well. Related to Airy functions.
potentialDescriptions.coulomb1D: One-dimensional hydrogen-like attractive potential. Energy levels follow 1/n² pattern.
potentialDescriptions.doubleSquareWell: Two square wells separated by barrier. Demonstrates quantum tunneling and energy level splitting.
potentialDescriptions.doublePoschlTeller: Two smooth Pöschl–Teller wells. Shows tunneling and energy level splitting.
potentialDescriptions.multiSquareWell: Multiple square wells forming a periodic structure. Models solid state physics and band structure.
potentialDescriptions.multiPoschlTeller: A row of smooth Pöschl–Teller wells. Shows coupled bound states and energy bands.
potentialDescriptions.custom: Custom quantum potential defined by user parameters.

superpositionDescriptions.single: Shows the energy level selected on the chart. Its probability density stays the same over time.
superpositionDescriptions.psiIPsiJ: Equal combination of two selected energy states. Its probability density changes over time.
superpositionDescriptions.localized: Gaussian wave packet centered at the chosen position and width, projected onto the available bound states.
superpositionDescriptions.movingLocalized: Localized wave packet with a chosen momentum. Its complex phases make it move across the potential.
superpositionDescriptions.twoLobed: Two separated wave packets with a chosen relative phase. Their overlap creates interference.
superpositionDescriptions.coherent: Coherent state superposition. Minimal uncertainty wavepacket that oscillates.
superpositionDescriptions.custom: Custom superposition configured by user. Arbitrary linear combination of eigenstates.

displayModeDescriptions.probabilityDensity: Showing probability density |ψ(x)|². Indicates where the particle is most likely to be found.
displayModeDescriptions.waveFunction: Showing wavefunction components. Real and imaginary parts of the complex quantum state.
displayModeDescriptions.phaseColor: Showing phase angle of complex wavefunction. Color-coded visualization of quantum phase.

parameterEffects.particleMass: Affects energy levels and wavefunction wavelength. Heavier particles have lower energies.
parameterEffects.wellWidth: Changes spatial extent of potential well. Wider wells have more closely spaced energy levels.
parameterEffects.wellDepth: Changes potential energy at bottom of well. Deeper wells support more bound states.
parameterEffects.barrierHeight: Controls height of potential barrier. Affects tunneling probability and energy levels.
parameterEffects.potentialOffset: Shifts entire potential up or down. Changes absolute energy values of all states.
parameterEffects.wellSeparation: Changes distance between wells. Affects quantum tunneling between wells and energy level splitting.
parameterEffects.numberOfWells: Changes number of wells in periodic structure. More wells create band structure effects.
parameterEffects.electricField: Applies uniform electric field to wells. Creates energy tilt and Stark effect.
parameterEffects.coherentDisplacement: Changes the initial position of the coherent wavepacket.
